## **Horizons 是 Rubius 系列中萬眾期待的模組包！**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/JvHIjLTtNSU" title="YouTube 影片播放器" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


下方有英文說明 :)

現在你將能享受系列中的所有內容，包含特色模組如 Distant Horizons、Terralith/Tectonic、Iris 光影、大規模毀滅 Boss 等等，為你帶來類似原版的體驗 ![cluless](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32a564fd55ae0a1c3cb4aecaff375da36ebf7a63.png)

此模組包將在系列中持續更新，加入新內容並平衡部分設定，以打造獨一無二的體驗。

### ![nerd](https://cdn.betterttv.net/emote/63a2a01e91ab7f35abe014d7/2x) 注意事項：
- 建議分配 8GB 以上的 RAM 以獲得最佳效能，但若能分配更多則更佳，我們通常使用 8 到 16 GB。
- 強烈建議使用 [chunky](https://modrinth.com/plugin/chunky) 模組預先載入區塊/地平線，以避免效能問題。
- 你需要自行下載 [光影](https://gist.github.com/Steveplays28/52db568f297ded527da56dbe6deeec0e)，因為它們未提供於 Modrinth（Rubius 使用的是 Bliss 光影）。
- 可透過內建模組進行多人遊戲（詳情請見教學）。
- 部分模組仍處於測試階段，因此可能出現錯誤並導致遊戲不穩定。
- 若自行添加模組，我們無法保證一切正常運作，但原則上不會有問題。

## Chunky 基本指令：


**/chunky world [維度]**

**/chunky center <x> <z>** ← _你的座標_

**/chunky shape circle**

**/chunky radius <1000>** ← _以方塊為單位的半徑_

**/chunky start**




<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/tGtTKCZ9QKg" title="YouTube 影片播放器" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### 英文說明：![Murica](https://cdn.frankerfacez.com/emote/229486/1)
Horizons is the long awaited modpack of the Rubius series! 
Now you will be able to enjoy all the content of the series with mods like Distant Horizons, Terralith/Tectonic, Iris shaders, Bosses of mass destruction, and more, giving you a vanilla+ experience ![cluless](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32a564fd55ae0a1c3cb4aecaff375da36ebf7a63.png)

This modpack will be updating throughout the series, adding new content and balancing some things to make it a unique experience. 

**Things to keep in mind:** 
- 8gb of RAM upwards for optimal performance, but if you can set more it's better, we use between 10 to 16.
- It is highly recommended that you use the [chunky](https://modrinth.com/plugin/chunky) mod to get the horizons to load properly and avoid performance problems as the world is so big.
- You will have to download the [Distant Horizons compatible](https://gist.github.com/Steveplays28/52db568f297ded527da56dbe6deeec0e) Bliss shaders on your own as they are not available in Modrinth.
- Some mods are in beta, therefore, there may be bugs and make the game unstable.
- If you add your own mods we do not guarantee that everything will work fine, but there should be no problem.

## Chunky essentials:


**/chunky world [dimension]**

**/chunky center <x> <z>** ← _your coords_

**/chunky shape [[shape](https://github.com/pop4959/Chunky/wiki/Shapes)]**

**/chunky radius <1000>** ← _radius in blocks_

**/chunky start**
